name: Camp Hays (Soundview Family YMCA Summer Day Camp)
description_short: A YMCA day camp in Branford, CT for ages 3–15, with campers grouped by grade they are entering and a Counselor-in-Training program for 14–15 year olds. Campers rotate through 35-minute activity periods such as gaga, arts & crafts, archery, sports and nature, and each week has a theme.
activities: Themed Wacky Wednesday dress-up and games
refund_policy_summary: A $50 deposit per camper per week is due at registration and cannot be refunded or transferred. Fees are due in full the Monday two weeks before each session. Refund requests must be in writing; none are given within 2 weeks of a session except for medical emergencies with a doctor's note, and there is a $10 fee on all refunds.
special_needs_notes: The Y says it works with children of all abilities. Families whose child needs social, behavioral or medical accommodations should contact the Camp Director.

sessions.name: Week 1: Aloha, Bonjour, Hola, Guten Tag, Ciao, Salve

warnings: Old season: the guide covers summer 2026, which ended before today (2026-10-13). Dates and fees for 2027 are not in this source.

The fee table looks unreliable. It shows $99 for every camp group for both members and program participants, and the date ranges are typos ('6/15/25-8/21/2'). It does not say whether $99 is a weekly rate. Confirm the real price with the camp.
The dates conflict. The weekly themes run June 15 to August 21 (10 weeks), but the back page says 'SUMMER CAMP DATES: June 15 - August 28th'. That back-page section seems to cover all CCC YMCA camps.
The '3 years - 17 years' age range on the back page is for all CCC YMCA camps ('DEPENDING ON WHICH CAMP YOU CHOOSE'). Camp Hays itself says ages 3-15.
The PDF is hosted on the parent organization's site (cccymca.org) and lists other YMCA camp locations. Only the Camp Hays details were recorded.
Among the fees is a leftover template note: 'Include other fees/financial associated info.'

The brochure only gives the YMCA branch at 628 East Main Street, Branford. If camp is at a school in East Haven, the street address, city and zip are wrong.

What is the 2026 weekly price? The fee table says $99 for every group, member and non-member alike, which looks like an unfilled template (it also says 'Include other fees/financial associated info'). Ask the camp or wait for the 2027 brochure.
Only 2026 material is posted; 2027 registration opens in January per the brochure pattern.
